display_information.name: Aishwarya's AI Twin
display_information.description: Ask Aishwarya Reganti's AI twin about AI engineering, evals, agents and AI careers, by text or voice.
display_information.long_description: An AI twin of Aishwarya Reganti, Founder and CEO of LevelUp Labs, built only from her own LinkedIn posts and YouTube videos. @mention it in any channel it has been added to, by text or with a voice recording, and it answers in a thread. Send it a voice message and it replies with a voice message in her voice. You can also send it a direct message. It is a demo by TrainerTwin and not a replacement for Aishwarya. Type /call-aishwarya to start a one-to-one voice call with her twin.

slash_commands.description: Start a one-to-one voice call with Aishwarya's twin
